text.en: Plugin updates start correctly from the update button. Failed requests identify the plugin and retain their reason in update details for retry.
text.zh-CN: 修复点击插件更新按钮后请求未发出的问题；失败提示显示插件名，并在更新详情中保留原因，方便查看和重试。

text.en: Visual Curator screens candidate previews before detailed review and reuses known image exclusions to reduce repeated work.
text.zh-CN: 视觉策展先筛选候选预览，再深入复核，并复用已知图片排除记录，减少重复分析。

text.en: Saved Visual Curator datasets can be selected across conversations and configured models within their training collection, including completed packages created by older versions.
text.zh-CN: 修复已有完整数据集却无法选择的问题；视觉策展数据集按训练集管理，支持跨会话和模型复用旧版完整包。

text.en: macOS GitHub updates use single Range requests for subsequent differential downloads, avoiding full-download fallback when multipart requests are rejected. Older clients may still download this update in full.
text.zh-CN: 优化 macOS 后续差分更新的下载兼容性，避免下载线路拒绝多段请求时退回完整下载。旧版首次升级仍可能下载完整包。

text.en: Plugin updates blocked by dependency scripts now show the exact packages and an explicit approval-and-retry action. Refreshing retains the pending decision, and automatic updates wait for approval.
text.zh-CN: 插件更新因依赖安装脚本受阻时，显示具体依赖并支持明确授权后重试；刷新保留待授权状态，自动更新等待授权。
